decisions.reason: The formwork profile system sits at the core of the firm's established formwork offer and had a dedicated page in both years, so the visible commitment and sunk investment favor keeping it.

The shuttering magnet block is a low-cost addition close to the established magnetic formwork line, and it stayed listed through 2019, so there is little reason to drop it despite its lower visibility.
This magnetic formwork component had its own page in 2018 and 2019, which signals strong public commitment and a central place in the formwork portfolio, so management would persist with it.
It is only mentioned on the website, but it belongs to the magnetic formwork family the firm is building out and costs little to keep, so management would retain it.
